notes:
Opportunity summary:
- Mid-market SaaS vendor (product analytics + in-app recommendations) exploring Redwood: start Hosted API for rapid rollout, transition to Dedicated dedicated pool for Q3-Q4 scale.
- Primary contact: Maren Holt (VP Product). Quote from call: "We need predictable unit economics for our recommendation engine — spikes during product launches kill our margins."
POC recap (Feb 18–Mar 4):
- POC scope: chat assistant (fine-tuned on Nebula corpus), embeddings for semantic search, and a reranker pipeline on sample traffic.
- Hosted API POC: 10k calls/day workload, observed median latency ~80ms, p95 ~220ms for chat gen on hosted model variant. Embeddings batch throughput: ~650 docs/min with batching config.
- Dedicated POC (short bench): single reserved node run with KV cache enabled: p95 reduced to ~120ms, cost projection down ~28% vs hosted at 100k qps-month equivalence.
- Quality: no regressions vs baseline open model; reranker reduced false positives in top-5 by 12%.
Commercial ask / negotiation points:
- Commit sizing: asking for 2x reserved GPU-equivalent capacity (baseline) with ramp schedule: 50% commit in month 1, 85% by month 3, 100% by month 6.
- Burst: need guaranteed burst to 4x baseline for 48 hours for product launches; ask for defined burst pools and pre-warming.
- Overage: prefer flat overage price at 1.4x committed unit price for first 20% overage then step to 1.75x.
- Ramp credits: requested 3 months of step-up credits as they onboard to Dedicated (we proposed 2 months).
- Term: leaning to 24-month reserved contract; procurement pushing for flexibility (CPI escalation cap + quarterly review).
Security / compliance notes:
- Must pass KMS flow review — they will manage keys in their cloud account but require Redwood support for envelope encryption integration.
- Require SOC2 + SSO/SAML integration and per-route audit logs with 12 months retention.
Commercial sensitivity & pricing:
- Highly cost-sensitive on per-token unit economics for embeddings and reranker (high QPS). If Redwood can meet the committed cost target they will convert from hosted.

- 2026-02-10: Intro call (Sophie + Maren).
- 2026-02-18: Hosted API POC kickoff; sample dataset received.
- 2026-02-28: Mid-POC sync, Fireflies ff_20260228_7843 (performance notes).

- 2026-03-05: Procurement indicated internal budget committee meets 3/18.

- SE: deliver detailed KMS integration note + sample envelope flow by 2026-03-10 (Marco).
